summary: Browse offline SRD references and manage tabletop combat.
page_description: Offline SRD reference and table tools for spell lookups, monster stat blocks, dice, initiative, and party HP.
release_notes: Choose named filters and browse complete result pages at every text size.
user: Somebody running a tabletop game who wants the book off the table.
job: Look up a rule in the offline reference and run the combat you are in.
offline: The reference and your encounter live on the reader; it never touches the network.

data.kind: the encounter in progress, with its combatants and notes
data.location: the app's private storage on the reader
data.export: not offered; it exists so a paused combat continues

non_goals: It does not download new reference material.
It does not run a campaign for you.
